If you need us to stop using specific information, you may submit a request through the channels stated in this Policy.

sections.body: To keep the Service running properly, maintain login state and remember your preferences, we may use cookies, local storage (LocalStorage), session storage and similar technologies. Authentication cookies maintain your login session during your visit and are necessary for the Service; preference storage remembers settings such as theme mode and language. You may manage or delete cookies through your browser settings, but after deleting authentication cookies you will need to log in again to use features requiring identity recognition. We will not use cookies for any purpose beyond those stated in this Policy. Where the platform embeds third-party components (such as third-party login entries), such parties may set cookies under their own policies; we suggest reading their policy statements.

sections.heading: How We Share, Transfer and Publicly Disclose Your Information
sections.body: We do not actively share your personal information with third parties, except in the following situations: 1) with your explicit prior authorization and consent; 2) as necessary to provide the Service, transmitting necessary data to entrusted processors providing infrastructure and technical support (such as cloud servers, object storage, database services and AI model providers), with whom we sign strict confidentiality and data processing agreements requiring them to process data only within the scope of this Policy; 3) as mandatorily required by laws and regulations, litigation dispute resolution, or administrative or judicial authorities; 4) in the event of merger, acquisition or asset reorganization, where transfer of personal information requires the new holder to remain bound by this Policy, or we will require them to obtain your authorization again. In addition, we will not publicly disclose your personal information except with your explicit consent or as required by law. Apart from the above, we do not share your information: sharing you initiate (such as sharing literature with group members) is decided by you autonomously.

sections.heading: How We Store and Protect Your Information
sections.body: Your personal information is stored on servers within the People's Republic of China (where cross-border transfer is involved, we will fulfill the corresponding obligations as required by law). The storage period is the shortest time necessary to achieve the purposes described in this Policy, unless mandatory legal provisions require otherwise; after the period expires, we will delete or anonymize your personal information. We use industry-standard security technologies, including but not limited to: encrypted transmission (HTTPS/TLS), password hash storage, access control and the least-privilege principle, log auditing, and backup and disaster recovery mechanisms. We have also established comprehensive information security management systems and emergency response procedures. Despite the above measures, please understand that no technical means can absolutely guarantee information security and the Internet environment carries inherent risks. If an unfortunate personal information security incident occurs, we will promptly activate emergency plans as required by law, inform you within the prescribed time limit of the incident, its possible impact and the remedial measures taken, and report to the competent authorities.

sections.heading: Your Rights
sections.body: In accordance with applicable laws and regulations, you have the following rights over your personal information: 1) Access and copy: you may view and export your basic profile, paper lists, notes and annotations at any time within the platform; 2) Correction and completion: when you find that the information we process about you is incorrect, you have the right to request correction or completion, and you may also modify most of your profile yourself in settings; 3) Deletion: in the circumstances prescribed by law (for example, where the processing purpose has been achieved, or we process information in violation of law or agreement), you have the right to request deletion of your personal information; you may also delete your notes, annotations, uploaded papers and other content yourself; 4) Withdrawal of consent: you may withdraw authorization by canceling your account or disabling the relevant features; withdrawal does not affect processing already carried out based on authorization; 5) Account cancellation: you may apply to cancel your account through the settings page or by contacting us; within a reasonable period after identity verification we will delete or anonymize your personal information, except where retention is required by law; 6) Copy and portability: within technical feasibility and legal compliance, we support obtaining a copy of your personal information. To protect security, we may need to verify your identity before responding to such requests. We will respond within fifteen business days; reasonable requests are free of charge, but repeated or excessive requests from the same user may incur necessary cost fees.

sections.heading: Processing of AI-Feature-Related Data
sections.body: When you use the AI-assisted reading features, we process the related data as follows: 1) Input content: the text you select, uploaded pages and questions you enter are transmitted to the model processing environment to generate results; following the minimization principle, we transmit only the content necessary for the feature; 2) Processing method: the model service may process your input automatically to produce output, performed by the service provider under the data processing agreement signed with us; we require that they must not use your input to train models intended for public use or for other commercial purposes; 3) Output content: AI-generated summaries, answers and other results are displayed to you and may be cached to improve performance; 4) Feedback data: your thumbs-up, thumbs-down or correction feedback on results is used to improve feature quality. Please be careful not to include others' private or highly sensitive information in AI inputs; liability arising from content you actively enter is handled in accordance with the Terms of Use.

sections.heading: Protection of Minors' Personal Information
sections.body: We attach great importance to the protection of minors' personal information. The Service is primarily intended for adult users; if you are under eighteen, please use the Service with the consent and guidance of your guardian, who should help you read and agree to this Policy. If we discover that we have collected a minor's personal information without prior guardian consent, we will try to delete the relevant data as soon as possible. A minor's guardian may contact us through the channels stated in this Policy to exercise rights of access, correction and deletion, and we will cooperate as required by law after verifying guardianship.

sections.heading: Updates to This Policy
sections.body: We may revise this Policy from time to time. Without your explicit consent, we will not reduce the rights you are entitled to under this Policy. For material changes, we will notify you prominently through in-product announcements, prompts or email, and update the "Last updated" date at the top of the page. Changes include, but are not limited to: changes to our basic information, changes to the purposes/methods/types of personal information processing, and changes to your rights and how to exercise them. If you continue to use the Service after the update, you are deemed to have read and understood the updated Policy; if you do not agree, please stop using the Service and may choose to cancel your account.

sections.heading: How to Contact Us
sections.body: If you have any questions, comments or suggestions about this Policy or personal information protection, or believe that our processing has infringed your lawful rights, you may contact us through in-product feedback ("Settings — Feedback") or the support email published by the operator. We will reply within fifteen business days after receiving your request. If you are not satisfied with our response, especially where you believe our conduct has harmed your lawful rights, you may also complain to or report to the relevant cyberspace administration, personal information protection agency or other competent authorities.

sections.heading: Exceptions to Obtaining Consent
sections.body: In accordance with applicable laws and regulations, we may collect and use your personal information without your authorization in the following circumstances: 1) as necessary to conclude or perform a contract to which you are a party, such as providing the core reading and note features; 2) as necessary to perform statutory duties or obligations, such as cooperating with judicial investigations; 3) as necessary in response to a public health emergency, or to protect your life, health or property in an emergency; 4) processing personal information you have made public yourself or that has been lawfully made public, within a reasonable scope; 5) processing personal information within a reasonable scope for news reporting or public-interest oversight; 6) other circumstances prescribed by law. Please understand that the determination of these exceptions follows legal provisions, and we will act within reasonable and necessary limits.

sections.heading: Protection of Sensitive Personal Information
sections.body: We understand that certain information, once leaked or illegally used, can easily harm your human dignity or endanger your personal or property safety, and constitutes sensitive personal information, such as biometrics, religious beliefs, specific identity, medical health, financial accounts and location traces. As an academic reading tool, the Service by principle does not actively collect such sensitive personal information. Please be cautious when entering such information in notes, annotations, discussions and direct messages. If you voluntarily include sensitive personal information in your User Content, we will apply the same protective measures as for general personal information, but you should be aware of and assess the corresponding risks yourself. If you find that someone else's content contains your sensitive personal information without consent, you may report it to us and we will handle it as required by law.

sections.heading: Account Cancellation Details
sections.body: When you decide to cancel your account, you may initiate the application through the account settings page or submit a request through the contact channels stated in this Policy. We will verify your identity after receiving the application and perform cancellation within a reasonable period after verification. The consequences of cancellation include: 1) you will no longer be able to use services requiring that account identity, and the papers, notes, annotations, discussions and direct messages related to the account will become inaccessible; 2) we will delete or anonymize personal information related to the account, except records required by law (such as transaction and security logs) which will be kept for the prescribed period and used only within the scope necessary for the retention purpose; 3) data copies within an active backup cycle will be automatically deleted when the backup expires. Once cancellation is performed it cannot be reversed; please export any materials you need before cancellation.

sections.heading: Typical Scenarios of Sharing and Entrusted Processing
sections.body: To help you clearly understand data flows, we list typical scenarios here: 1) Cloud infrastructure: your data is stored on cloud servers and database services entrusted by us; providers only supply storage and computing resources and will not use your data for other purposes; 2) Document parsing: when you upload PDF and similar literature files, we may call document parsing services to extract metadata and body text; the data needed for parsing is handled as agreed after the task completes; 3) AI model services: input and output related to AI features are processed by model service providers under data processing agreements signed with us, limited to what is necessary for the features; 4) Email services: when you use email-related functions (such as password recovery), we send you email through email service providers; 5) Statistics and monitoring: for troubleshooting and performance improvement, we use logging and monitoring tools to process de-identified technical data. All such processors are strictly bound by contract and may not process data beyond the entrusted scope.

sections.heading: Cross-Border Data Transfer
sections.body: At present our servers and main data processing environments are located within the People's Republic of China. If technical architecture adjustments or the use of overseas third-party components (such as overseas login or model services) require your personal information to be transferred abroad, we will, as required by law, complete security assessment, standard contract filing or obtain your separate consent, and clearly explain to you the name and contact information of the overseas recipient, the processing purpose and method, and the types of personal information involved. We will continuously monitor the latest legal requirements on cross-border transfer and adjust data processing arrangements accordingly. If you have questions about cross-border transfer, please consult us through the channels stated in this Policy.

sections.heading: Automated Decision-Making and Personalized Experience
sections.body: The Service may use automated techniques in the following scenarios: 1) Related-literature recommendation: recommending potentially relevant papers based on the metadata of the literature you read and annotate; 2) Content ordering: ordering notifications and discussions by time and relevance. Such processing is only intended to improve browsing experience, does not involve decisions that significantly affect your rights and interests, and will not be used for differential pricing. You may at any time ask us to stop the related personalized processing by clearing data or contacting us. We will not use your personal information for profiling that treats you unfairly or unreasonably.

sections.heading: Organizational Safeguards for Information Security
sections.body: Beyond technical measures, we safeguard information security through organizational and institutional means: 1) designating a data security officer and responsible department, implementing data classification and grading management; 2) providing confidentiality training and permission management for employees who access personal information, signing confidentiality agreements, and assigning permissions under the least-necessity principle with periodic review; 3) establishing data access approval and log-trail mechanisms, monitoring and alerting on abnormal access; 4) maintaining emergency response plans for personal information security incidents and conducting regular drills; 5) conducting due diligence and contractual constraints on external partners, clarifying their security responsibilities. The implementation of these measures is subject to internal audits and may be subject to external inspection as required by regulators.

sections.heading: FAQ on Exercising Your Rights
sections.body: Common questions in practice include: 1) What does my export contain? The export scope is based on actual product capability and usually includes your basic profile and the paper lists, notes and annotations you created; 2) Why can some information still be found after deletion? Deletion immediately makes data inaccessible, but search index and cache updates may be briefly delayed, and backup copies are removed when the backup cycle expires; 3) What is the difference between cancellation and deletion? Cancellation applies to the entire account and all its data; deletion can apply to individual items; 4) I forgot my registered email — what should I do? You can recover access through other bound methods in account settings, or contact us for identity verification; 5) Is exercising rights free? Reasonable requests are free; repeated or excessive requests may incur reasonable cost fees. If you have other questions, please feel free to contact us.

sections.heading: Multi-Device and Data Synchronization
sections.body: When you log in to the same account on different devices, your papers, notes and annotations are synchronized on the server side to ensure a consistent cross-device experience. Synchronization uses encrypted transmission, and the server stores only the version data necessary for synchronization. Deletions on one device are synchronized to others; in case of sync conflicts (for example, offline edits merged after going online), the system handles them according to a preset merge strategy and tries to preserve both versions of content. If you do not want certain content synchronized, you may use the corresponding features locally only (where supported) or edit after logging out. For data overwrites or losses caused by the sync mechanism, we will try our best to assist recovery from backups, but recovery may not always be possible; we recommend regularly exporting important content.

sections.heading: Third-Party Components and Open-Source Licenses
sections.body: The platform is built with many excellent open-source components and third-party libraries. The license information of these components does not alter our commitments to you under this Policy: we bear the same level of protection obligations for data processed through components as for direct processing. Some components may generate technical logs (such as framework error reporting) during operation; we require, or configure where technically feasible, that only de-identified technical information is collected. The full texts and rights statements of open-source licenses are as published by each component; if you need the list of major open-source components used by the platform, you may request it via the support email.

sections.heading: Regulatory Compliance and Audits
sections.body: We will actively cooperate with supervisory inspection and compliance audit requirements, providing necessary materials and explanations as required by law. Within the scope permitted by law, we also proactively conduct compliance self-assessments, including personal information protection impact assessments (PIA) and security testing, and continuously improve protection measures based on the results. When new laws, regulations, national standards or industry norms impose higher requirements on the matters described in this Policy, we will promptly update this Policy and internal systems to ensure continued compliance with the latest baseline.

sections.heading: Glossary
sections.body: To help you understand this Policy, we explain the main terms as follows: 1) Personal information: various information recorded electronically or otherwise relating to an identified or identifiable natural person, excluding anonymized information; 2) Sensitive personal information: personal information that, once leaked or illegally used, can easily harm a natural person's human dignity or endanger personal or property safety; 3) Anonymization: the process of processing personal information so that it cannot identify a specific natural person and cannot be restored; 4) De-identification: the process of processing personal information so that it cannot identify a specific natural person without additional information; 5) Entrusted processor: an organization or individual that processes personal information for us under our instructions; 6) Backup cycle: the length of time data copies are retained for disaster recovery, after which the copies are removed.

sections.heading: Account Security Recommendations
sections.body: Protecting personal information is not only our responsibility but also requires your participation. We recommend that you: 1) set a strong password (a combination of letters, numbers and symbols) and avoid reusing the same password across websites; 2) never disclose your account, password or session credentials to others, including anyone claiming to be our customer service — our staff will never ask for your password; 3) log out promptly after using the Service on unfamiliar devices; 4) periodically review login activity and authorizations, and change your password and contact us if you notice anything abnormal; 5) handle links and attachments from unknown sources carefully to guard against phishing. If you suspect any anomaly in your account, please contact us immediately through the channels stated in this Policy, and we will assist you in freezing the account, resetting the password and investigating the risk.

sections.heading: Log and Audit Data
sections.body: To keep the Service secure, troubleshoot failures and meet compliance requirements, we record necessary technical logs, including request time, request address, operation type, result status and source address. Log data is de-identified, access is strictly controlled, and the retention period generally does not exceed the statutory maximum. Logs are mainly used to: identify and block attacks, analyze system performance bottlenecks, reproduce and fix failures, and support investigation of security incidents. Logs are not used for commercial profiling of you, nor shared with third parties for marketing purposes. If you have questions about records concerning you in the logs, you may consult us, and we will explain the handling to the extent permitted by law.

sections.heading: Data Classification and Grading
sections.body: We classify and grade data by sensitivity and business importance: 1) Identity credentials (such as password hashes and session tokens) are protected at the highest level with hashed and encrypted storage and dual authorization for access; 2) Personal profiles (such as email and nickname) are under strict access control, visible only in the links necessary for the features; 3) User content (such as papers, notes and annotations) belongs to you; we store and process it per your instructions and do not conduct content review (except as required by law); 4) Technical logs (such as access records) are stored in de-identified form for operations and security purposes. Different levels of data follow differentiated controls in storage, transmission, access and destruction; the higher the level, the stricter the control.

sections.heading: Data Stored Locally in Your Browser
sections.body: To improve your experience, some data is stored locally in your browser, including: login session credentials (to avoid repeated login), interface preferences (such as theme mode, language selection and reader settings), and temporary editing caches (to prevent content loss from accidental closure). Such local data is stored only on your device; you may delete it via your browser's clear-data function or trigger cleanup using the platform's logout function. Please note that after clearing local data you need to log in again and some preferences will revert to defaults. On public or shared devices, we recommend using incognito mode and logging out afterwards to prevent subsequent users from obtaining your personal information.

sections.heading: Data Arrangements in Cooperation and Merger Scenarios
sections.body: If we undergo a merger, acquisition, asset transfer or similar transaction, your personal information may be part of the transferred assets. In such cases, we will: 1) assess the recipient's data protection capability before the transaction; 2) require the recipient to continue performing the obligations under this Policy, or re-obtain your consent before any policy change; 3) inform you of the recipient's name and contact information through announcements as required by law. If the form of the Service changes after the transaction (such as renaming or feature consolidation), we will notify you within a reasonable period and ensure that your rights to access, correct, delete and cancel are unaffected.

sections.heading: Error Correction and Data Quality
sections.body: We strive to keep the personal information we process accurate, complete and up to date. If you find errors in the information we process about you (for example, a wrong registered email or inaccurate profile), you can correct it yourself via the settings page or contact us for correction. For correction requests, we will first verify your identity and then complete the correction within a reasonable period, synchronizing the result to relevant systems. Where correction involves third parties (such as an SSO identity source), we may need to coordinate with them and will inform you of the expected completion time. Data quality is vital to service quality; thank you for helping us keep information accurate.

sections.heading: Privacy-by-Design Principles
sections.body: During product and service design, we follow the "privacy by default" and "privacy by design" principles: 1) conduct a personal information protection impact assessment before new features launch to identify and reduce privacy risks; 2) adopt minimization in default configurations, with non-essential permissions disabled by default; 3) follow visibility minimization for data display: your notes and annotations are visible only to you by default, and sharing requires your active initiation; 4) build export and deletion as standard capabilities rather than after-the-fact patches; 5) follow the minimum-field principle for external interfaces to avoid over-exposing data. These principles run through the entire product life cycle, including requirement review, development, testing and operation.

sections.heading: Scope of This Policy
sections.body: This Policy applies to our processing of your personal information through the platform. The following situations are not covered by this Policy and are governed by the corresponding policies or handled by the corresponding parties: 1) third-party websites or services you visit (even via links from the platform), whose processing is subject to their own privacy policies; 2) authorization operations you complete on third-party account platforms (such as GitHub), where the relevant processing is governed by the platform's policies and we only receive the information confirmed on the authorization page; 3) privately deployed versions (if any) uniformly procured, deployed or managed by your institution, where the data processing party and rules follow the agreement between the institution and the operator. Please distinguish the processing party in different scenarios and read the relevant terms carefully.

sections.heading: Complaints and Supervision
sections.body: If you believe our personal information processing has harmed your lawful rights, you may protect your rights through: 1) submitting a complaint to us stating the facts, reasons and demands; we will process and reply within fifteen business days; 2) complaining or reporting to the cyberspace administration or other departments performing personal information protection duties; 3) filing a lawsuit with the people's court according to law. We promise not to restrict or discriminate against your account in any form because you exercise the above rights. For verified violations, we will bear responsibility as required by law, take corrective measures, and feed back the results to you.

sections.heading: Relationship with the Terms of Use
sections.body: This Policy and the Terms of Use together constitute the complete legal documents on which your use of the Service is based. Where this Policy and the Terms of Use are inconsistent regarding personal information processing, this Policy prevails; matters not covered by this Policy are handled with reference to the Terms of Use. Where laws impose mandatory requirements on personal information processing, the law prevails regardless of this Policy. By using the Service you indicate that you have read and agreed to both documents; your disagreement with either means you should stop using the Service.

sections.heading: Example Scenarios
sections.body: To help you understand this Policy intuitively, we provide the following examples: Example 1: you register with an email; we store only the email address and password hash, and do not require your real name or phone number. Example 2: you log in with GitHub; we only obtain the basic information you confirm on the GitHub authorization page and never read your code repositories. Example 3: you use an AI feature to ask about the meaning of a paragraph; only that paragraph and your question are transmitted to the model environment, and your other notes are not sent along. Example 4: you share a paper with a research group; group members can view the shared content of that paper, but your other unshared papers remain visible only to you. Example 5: you apply for account cancellation; after identity verification we delete your personal data, and backup copies are automatically removed when the backup cycle expires. These examples illustrate the processing logic; the actual product implementation and the body of this Policy prevail.

sections.heading: Version and Effectiveness
sections.body: This Policy is version V1.0 and takes effect from the date of publication. We will record a summary and update time for each material change on this page for your reference. If you continue to use the Service after this Policy is updated, you accept the updated content; if you do not agree, you may stop using the Service and apply to cancel your account. We suggest you review this Policy regularly to understand how we protect your personal information. Thank you for your trust in PaperHelper — we will continue to handle your data with prudence and transparency.
